mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 49 degrees with clear skies near City Hall. We also have a new moon tonight, and while the ISS will pass overhead, you will not be able to see it due to the clouds.
The City of Verona is working on the Mark Drive reconstruction project between North Nine Mound Road and Westlawn Avenue, which involves major utility upgrades and new sidewalk installations.
There is plenty to do around town today with trivia at Hop Haus, Wisconsin Brewing Company, and Paddy Mac's, plus yoga and live music coming up tomorrow.
In a report from October 25, officers arrested a man for an O W I offence after finding him unresponsive in his vehicle at the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue.
Stop by Culver's today to enjoy the Chocolate Heath Crunch, as they are currently open and serving until 10 PM.
